$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of a docs member's docs.yaml, its site settings. Boundary: shape only; the navigation is content/**/meta.json and a docs member is always a Fumadocs site, so neither navigation nor theme is a key; `stackra gen` (readDocsYaml in @stackra/gen) checks the same shape. Shipped as @stackra/gen/schema/docs.json, a byte copy. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0514 (amendment of 2026-11-09: the docs member).
title: docs.yaml (docs member)
description: The site settings of a docs member (a workspace member whose package.json has "stackra": { "kind": "docs" }): every DocsConfig field but navigation and theme. Pages, assets and snippets live under content/, and each folder's navigation in its content/**/meta.json. `stackra gen` writes the Fumadocs site into .stackra/site/.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

name.description: The site name; also the title of the first tab when content/meta.json has no title.

description.description: One sentence for search engines and the site header.

light.description: The primary colour in dark mode.

dark.description: A darker shade of the primary colour.

logo.description: The logo for light and dark mode, as paths under content/assets.

href.description: Where the logo links; the site root when absent.

favicon.description: The favicon, a path under content/assets.

navbar.description: The navbar links and its one primary button.

footer.description: The footer: social profile URLs by network, and link columns.

apiReference.description: The service keys whose API reference the site carries, from each service's committed stackra.manifest.json.

locales.description: The site's languages, the default first. A page of another locale sits beside its default page as <page>.<code>.mdx and is served under /<code>/.

code.description: Lower case, with an optional upper-case region.

label.description: The name in the language switch, in that language.

dir.description: The text direction; ltr when absent.

default.description: The locale whose pages are the source pages.

labels.description: Tab and group names in this language, by their default-locale name.

redirects.description: Paths that moved: each from answers with a permanent redirect to to, a page path or an absolute URL.

raw.description: Fumadocs layout options gen does not own, passed through as they are; nav, links, tree and children are refused.

href.description: An absolute URL, or a site path such as /quickstart.
